about: The keys the flight scene reads by itself, outside the key table (shared/terrain/terrain_view.gd _own_key; docs/controls.md "Own keys"), that work in Modern IAF and have no record in its key table (the roll trim, MPO, STORES CONFIG and the GPS bomb's keys are records 202–207 of modern-iaf/data/keys.json since 2026-11-18): the key card draws them with the table's (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md §3). code: the key's constants in that file; tools/manuals.py stops the build when the file no longer names one.
